# What a PR labelled "post-merge-review" may touch.
#
# A labelled PR passes the "post-merge-review paths" check only if EVERY
# changed file (both names of a rename) matches an allow line and no "!"
# line. Anything not allowed is denied: new files start denied. A PR that
# fails keeps the full review before merge. Without the label the check
# passes and nothing changes.
#
# One bash glob per line, matched against the repo-relative path; "*" also
# matches "/". A line starting with "!" denies, and wins over any allow line.
# Blank lines and text after "#" are ignored. The check reads this file from
# the base branch, so a PR cannot loosen its own check; a missing or empty
# file fails the check.

# ---- Allowed ----

# Docs.
docs/*
*.md

# Test harness and tests (a test file in a denied directory stays denied).
internal/testops/*
cmd/sw-testops/*
*_test.go

# Status, metrics and observation files, by name.
core/host/master/observation_service.go
core/host/master/observation_snapshot.go
core/host/volume/memory_status.go
core/host/volume/status_server.go
core/ops/observation.go
core/ops/observation_bundle.go
core/ops/observation_dashboard.go
core/ops/observation_report.go
core/ops/volume_status_artifacts.go
core/ops/volume_status_report.go
core/ops/volume_status_report_collector.go
core/ops/volume_status_summary.go

# ---- Denied even if allowed above ----

# The check itself and CI.
!.github/*

# Data path and replication.
!core/storage/*
!core/frontend/*
!core/transport/*
!core/replication/*
!core/recovery/*
!core/engine/*
!core/adapter/*

# Authority: lease, epoch, fencing, move.
!core/authority/*
!core/host/master/workspace_*
!core/host/volume/workspace_*
!cmd/blockvolume/workspace_lease*

# Wire and persisted formats.
!*.proto
!*.pb.go

# Lease, epoch, claim, admission, GC, delete or format code (tests included)
# wherever it lives, by file name.
!*/lease*.go
!*_lease*.go
!*epoch*.go
!*fenc*.go
!*claim*.go
!*admission*.go
!*/gc_*.go
!*_gc.go
!*_gc_*.go
!*delet*.go
!*purge*.go
!*persist*.go
!*journal*.go
!*format*.go
